notes.title: [Notice] LoveBeat Policies on inappropriate chatting and Nicknames (Restrictions)
notes.content:
Hello, this is GM Love.

Reports on inappropriate or offensive chatting and Nicknames had occurred constantly. The reported offenders got warnings or restrictions until now. However, since the number of reports has increased recently, we decided to intensify the behavior initiatives for the clean LoveBeat. This policy will be enacted as soon as this post’s up on the web page. Whoever violates the rules will be restricted without any prior notification.

[h1]Policies on Chatting and Nicknames[/h1]
Followings are the leading rules. [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=4045-USHJ-3810]For the detailed contents, please refer the Steam regulations.[/url]
[list][*]Flame or insult other players
[*]Bypass any filters
[*]Abusing chatting or Shoutout by repeating same chats that give disapproval to others
[*]Inappropriate or offensive chats and Nickname; Swearing, cursing, porn, hacking, racism, drugs, and the words others may feel discomfort.[/list]

[h1]Restrictions on the reported offenders on chatting[/h1]
[list][*]Initial penalty: Warning
[*]Secondary penalty: Block chatting for 7 days
[*]Third time reported: Block chatting for 15 days[/list]

[h1]Restrictions on inappropriate Nicknames[/h1]
[list][*]Initial penalty: Forces to change Nickname with an offer of ‘Name change’ item
[*]Secondary penalty: Forces to change Nickname (will be no provision of ‘Name change’ item)[/list]
[b]※ Reported nicknames might be blocked in the system[/b]

[h1]How to report the abusive users[/h1]
Whoever notice the abusive or offensive users in the game, please report to LoveBeat CS through email ([b]lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr[/b]) with the following information:
[list][*]LoveBeat nickname of the reporter.
[*]The abuser’s LoveBeat nickname.
[*]The screenshots for the evidence of your report. If you are reporting for the inappropriate nicknames, no further description is needed.
[*]A detailed explanation of the situation you’ve encountered.
[*]The exact time when the reporting issue happened.[/list]

Depending on the committed violation, more intensive restriction or even a [b]permanent exclusion[/b] can be enacted to the offenders. Players who have any concern and conflict to others can send an email to ([b]lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr[/b]) for the resolution. Revocation is possible if you can confirm that the issue was not intentional. However, we are not responsible for any inquiry disadvantages occurred by restriction.

Thank you for your cooperation.

notes.content:

Hello, Dancers.

Show your Christmas Look! We’ll give 100% coupon to best 6 outfits and teen's Snowman Set (30days) to all participants. This contest ends on December 28, so be sure to check out this announcement for rules and eligibility.

[h1]1. Period[/h1]
　- Submission: December 15, 2016 - December 28, 2016 (Pacific time)
　- [Strike]Announce winners after event ends[/strike] [b] Reward Sent on Dec 29 [/b]

[h1]2. Prize[/h1]
　- 100% Coupon for The 3 Female Outfits (1 Teen, 1 Idol, 1 Kid)
　- 100% Coupon for The 3 Male Outfits (1 Teen, 1 Idol, 1 Kid)
　-[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/b87b4c0254a59ccbcfe5b9566db3584188918260.png] Teen's "Human Snowman" Set (30days) for all participants[/url]
　* This Snowman set isn’t same one from X-Mas Mystery Box.

[h1]3. How to Join the contest (Submission)[/h1]
[b]1) UPLOAD Christmas in-game outfit(s) on any site[/b]
　- Take a screenshot to show your Christmas theme in-game outfit(s) on LoveBeat Steam.
　- Upload it on any site as many as you want, but each outfit should be different. The more posts on multiple sites, The better chance which you get 100% discount coupon.
　- You can use your native language in the post.
　- Post it in the 'Public' setting, including LoveBeat Steam Link

[b]2) SUBMIT the post's link in Event announcement's comment[/b]
　- You have to provide your Steam account, in-game name and a link to your post by adding a comment [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/541952653248273704]at this event announcement.[/url]
　-[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/29ca9be214a9e1cebf4b6343dfeb65d231bbc810.jpg] Example of Submission[/url]

[b]3) RECEIVE Reward[/b]
　- We give all rewards after winner announcement. (Delivery date is to be announced.)
　- Only 1 Snowman Set is provided even if you submit many outfits.
　- Best outfits are decided by GM's opinion, referring to the number of post(s) and comment(s) in the post and more.

[h1]4. Remark[/h1]
　- Rules and eligibility are subject to change without prior notification.
　- All entries must be received within the submission date to be eligible to win a prize.
　- You will disqualify if you submit to the wrong place or don't follow the rules above.
　- [url=https://www.facebook.com/media/set/?set=a.715188715298775.1073741845.144496762367976&type=1&l=39da14ad6f]Good outfits will be posted in LoveBeat Lookbook on Facebook[/url]

[h1]5. Winners[/h1]
　- [url=https://www.facebook.com/permalink.php?story_fbid=1790166421232290&id=100007168486279] ‹‹3.Her's outfits! [/url]
　- [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=821370243/] Khunmei~'s ourfits! [/url]
　- [url=https://www.facebook.com/Candy.Hotaro/posts/10207485373722896] DeyHotaro's outfits! [/url]
　- [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=822260902] #Meow#'s outfits! [/url]
　- [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=822295185] Aifeiya's outfits! [/url]

[b]*Notice[/b]
- Some participants missed to put LoveBeat steam link on their posts, and I'm sorry we cannot give the reward to those who missed the event terms.
- We were planned to choose 3 female and male winners each, but there were no enough male participants. For that reason, only 2 winners from male outfit section had drafted. 

Thank you for your participation! :JoyfulLalabit:

notes.title: [Edit][Notice] Policy of Transactions refunded or charged back (Sanctions)
notes.content:
Hello, Dancers.

I inform you about purchases refunded or charged back. LoveBeat don’t support to refund Cash, but purchases are refunded or revoked by Valve if it’s fraudulent or disputed and there are people who make unfair profits from that. We will give a sanction without prior notification, according to below policy.

[h1]Sanctions[/h1]

[b]Sanction against player who gain Cash from transactions refunded or charged back. (“Abusers”)[/b]
　- 1st sanction: Revoke all Cash from the transactions
　- 2nd sanction: If we cannot revoke all Cash, in other words, if you already used the Cash, your account will be banned permanently.

[b]Sanction against player who received gifts from the abuser. (“Recipients”)[/b]
　- 1st sanction: Revoke all Gifts from the abusers.
　- 2nd sanction: If we cannot revoke all gifts – in other words, if you already used the gifts-, your account will be banned for a week (7 days).
　- 3rd sanction: After your account is banned temporarily, your account will be banned permanently if you receive gifts from abusers and we cannot revoke all gifts again.

[h1]Abusers[/h1]

[b]The list below is abusers who we banned permanently. (Pacific time)[/b]
　- Banned on November 3: YuuNakam***, Zch***, Zcht***, _Zch***, .Zch***, Habichue***, Natsuki~C*** (7 people)
　- Banned on November 7: Howar*** (1 person)
　- Banned on November 14: TheDance*** (1 person)
　- Banned on January 1: ASadCh*** (1 person)
　- Banned on January 8: Ren***, NatsumiC*** (2 people)
　- Banned on January 22: CherryCr*** (1 person)

 [b]The list below is abusers who we banned temporarily. (Pacific time)[/b]
　- Banned on November 10 and remove the ban after 1 week: Z*** (1 person)
　- Banned on November 24 and remove the ban after 1 week: Ze*** (1 person)
　- Banned on January 8 and removed the ban after 1 week: MantabJ***, Ax*** (2 people)

If you have concerns and disputes, it can be resolved by emailing [u]lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr[/u]. We can remove a ban if you prove that it’s unintentional, but we assume no responsibility for disadvantage of the sanction and transactions between players.

Thank you.

[b](Last updated on January 23)[/b]

[h1]Patch Note[/h1]
An update to LoveBeat will be released. The major changes include: 
[list][*] Marriage System
[list][*]Couple can marry by using “Happy Wedding” or “Gorgeous Wedding” and wedding has benefit and contents following:
[list][*]Give wedding outfits to you and your partner when purchase wedding item. Search its preview in the Artwork
[*]Give EXP, Hearts and Love Water to married couple (+ Brilliant Ruby and more EXP, Hearts, Love Water for Gorgeous Wedding)
[*]Give EXP, Hearts (+ Bouquet to a person) to people who observe wedding. (More EXP, Hearts for Gorgeous Wedding. The bouquet’s period and design depends on wedding type)
[*]Married couple can buy and use “Brilliant Ruby” (EXP+50%)
[*] Your Couple Grade changes to Marriage Grade 1, but days for date are remained.
[*]Couple nickname are removed but you can use wedding ring.
[*]Rewards for Marriage Grade up
[*]You can grow your Love Tree with your partner [/list]
[*]How to grow Love Tree
[olist][*]Purchase Love Water from Store or Get it by playing together with your partner (random)
[*]Open it in your inventory and then Receive it from your mailbox
[*]Click Love Tree ICON in marriage information page
[*]Select a song and Click Start button. 10000 Beat or 2 Hearts is needed for playing.
[*]Play by using arrow keys (Left, Down, Right)
[*]Reach the exp for Love Tree and then Harvest to receive rewards (Hearts and EXP)[/olist]

notes.title: [Notice] GameGuard Issue (Update)
notes.content:
Hello, This is GMLove.
First of all, I apologize for the difficulty and frustration.
I've got the report from many players about hacking, cheating and other inappropriate things, so my team updated GameGuard which is game security solution on July 11. We updated GameGuard to improve game security on July 27, but many players have reported problems after that. Therefore, we did roll back previous version @ 8:35 PM on July 28. (Pacific time) I apologize for GameGuard issue once again and will recover LB stamp on July 27, 28 for compensation. You will check the stamp on July 29.
If your problem continues, please check basic troubleshooting below and Contact LoveBeat support when you cannot resolve it with the guide. We will investigate your issue to resolve it as soon as possible.
I appreciate your interest and patience.

[b]Update: We performed GameGuard update to improve its compatibility and fix crashes between GameGuard and anti-virus software on 6:12 PM on August 3. Please close game and then run it again to update game and GameGuard.[/b]

[h1]Basic Troubleshooting[/h1]

[b]1. Log on as an administrator[/b]
GameGuard needs Windows administrator account. Please try to log on as an administrator and follow the link for your information. https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/14028/windows-7-how-log-on-as-an-administrator

[b]2. Delete GameGaurd folder[/b]
GameGuard is automatically downloaded and updated when running LoveBeat and Canceling or stopping GameGuard update causes problems. You try to download and update again after you delete GameGuard folder in LoveBeat installation directory.
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\LoveBeat (by default)

[b]3. Turn off or Uninstall anti-virus software[/b]
Some anti-virus software block or conflict with LoveBeat, or using 2+ anti-virus software might cause problems. Please turn off or uninstall all anti-virus software including McAfee.

[b]4. End unnecessary processes and software[/b]
Certain processes and software cause problems. Please end unnecessary processes and software in Task Manager, such as VPN, Sandboxie, Avast Online Scanner, other games which have game security solution (e.g. Xigncode) and so on.

[b]5. Check the error code[/b]
If a message appears, please check what it says. If there is certain number (error code), please follow the link for troubleshooting: http://www.gameguard.co.kr/eng/index.htm

[h1]Contact LoveBeat Support[/h1]

If the problem continues even after performing all of the troubleshooting steps in above guide, you will need to contact LoveBeat Support for further assistance. To ensure that your incident is handled in the quickest and most efficient manner possible, please follow these steps:

[b]1. Prepare DxDiag.txt[/b]
Please observe the following instructions to run and save DxDiag.txt:
1) Press Windows Key + R
2) Type DxDiag and press Enter
3) In the DxDiag window, click Save All Information
4) Name the file "dxdiag" and click Save
5) Exit the DirectX Diagnostic Tool

[b]2. Prepare GameGuard.zip[/b]
Please do the following to create GameGuard.zip:
1) Navigate to your LoveBeat installation directory
- By default: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\LoveBeat
2) Right-click on GameGuard folder
3) Hover your cursor over the “Send to” option. it will open a new submenu
4) Select “Compressed (zipped) folder”

[b]3. Prepare Screenshots[/b]
Please take a screenshot of your problem and all running processes in Task manager when you’re faced with the problem. You could open Task manager to press Ctrl+Alt+Delete.
Please follow the link about generating screenshots. http://www.take-a-screenshot.org/

[b]4. Submit Your Support Request by email[/b]
Email lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr to submit your request. Please write your LoveBeat name, Steam account, description about your problem and include your DxDiag.txt, GameGuard.zip, screenshot as an attachment to the incident.

notes.title: [Complete] Maintenance & Patch Note on July 13, 2016
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/8b2bb1ada497b91200519b1b178a056adbb92471.png[/img]
Hello, everyone. 
We will be performing scheduled maintenance to update and provide good service.
During this time the game will be unavailable for play. 

Date and time: July 13, 2016 @ 10:00 PM - July 14, @ 1:00AM @2:00 AM (Pacific Time) [b]Complete @1:00 AM[/b]
※ The time of maintenance might be changed depending on works.

[h1]Patch Note[/h1]
An update to LoveBeat will be released. The major changes include: 
[list][*]LoveBeat Summer Renewal: Basic waiting room and shop also changed
[*] Level-up rewards added (Max level 70)
[*]LoveBeat Stamp rewards changed
[*]Shout Filtering Option: Go to Option > Personal Settings > Shout Filtering (during a game), Click Appear in chat box and Confirm. Then, the message popup of All Shoutout doesn’t appear, but it shows in chat box during play.
[*]Screen Shortcut: Just Press [Alt]+[Enter] together. The screen in windowed mode changes to full screen and vice versa.
[*]New Item
[list][*] Personal Skin/BG “Summer”, Couple Skin/BG “Watermelon”, Fam Skin “Under Water Skin”
[*]Slot Skin: Decorate your slot in game room with “Yellow Star”, “Green Olive”, “On the Road”, “In the Car”, “City Night”, “Fancy Heart” (premium category)
[*]Super Power Series: Get Extra Beat, EXP, Love Point (VIP category). If someone uses Super Power item, other users in the game room also receive the bonus.
[*]73 parts, 12 accessories, 3 sets, 4 balloons[/list]
[*]New Songs
[list][*]Doll Face by Heifervescent
[*]Vanity Girl by JASON MILLER
[*]Over by July Season
[*]What a Perfect Summertime by Luigi Talluto
[*]Bad Chick by The.madpix.project[/list]
[*]Fixes and Other changes 
[list][*]Notice banners changed
[*]Some in-game text, icon changed[/list][/list]
Thank you.

notes.title: [Event-Result] Ask winners of LoveBeat Festival to send information again: Please check!
notes.content:
Hello, All winners of LoveBeat Festival.
I know you may concern there is no reply about that even if you send the necessary information.
I have difficulty to check winner’s information because there are frauds or missing info.
Therefore, I ask winners to send your e-mail list and share how to work with that.
Please read this post and follow it.

[h1]How to collect information and identify[/h1]
[b]1. Check you are the winner or not in here:[/b] http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791440550337/announcements/detail/826786191306863045
[b]2. If you’re the winner, write letter to me in-game following[/b]
- Receiver: GMLove
- Message: The message has to contain your e-mail address and your LoveBeat name. 
- Example
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/78f7f9819f33ae5f2b654bd4b0c6b907a0b3d625.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/1d4fce6a1d1e61900bf5ea0801eb6e1ede207625.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]3. I re-check your e-mail address and name and information which you’ve sent
4. I email to your e-mail address about your information for confirmation
5. If you confirm it, I send the rewards and give you the invoice.[/b]

I apologize in advance it’s possible to take few weeks because I’m unfamiliar with that and didn’t catch the possibility of the frauds. However, please don't worry or be disappointed. I will send you the rewards after all.

I’m appreciated about your patience.

notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/pLOYJLz.png[/IMG]
Thank you for love to LoveBeat! GMLove prepares special event for you.

Edit - This period is on 11th Feb - 9th Mar (before maintenance), but period is changed to start @ 11:30 PM on 10th Feb due to maintenance completed early.


[h1]1. Weekend Golden Time[/h1]
Play the game during event time with the mode, then get additional bonus in each game.

* Date and Time: @4AM - 6AM, @10AM - 12PM, @6PM - 8PM, every weekend (PST)
* Event Mode: Beat PangPang, Couple PangPang
* Bonus: +100 EXP, +300 Beat


[h1]2. Fix LoveBeat Text[/h1]
Please rewrite our text for better English and suitable for content.

[b]Mechanics[/b]
Post your rewritten text on "Fix LoveBeat Text" forum follwoing information:
 a. Your LoveBeat avatar's name(IGN)
 b. Screenshot of your suggestions
 c. Text in screenshot which you want to rewrite

notes.title: [End] [Event] 5 Open Events (period: 13th January – 10th February, Pacific Standard Time)
notes.content:
[IMG] http://i.imgur.com/4KJh8Mv.png [/IMG]
Welcome to LoveBeat Steam. There are 5 events to celebrate the opening Steam service. We share the event details in advance for people waiting LoveBeat Steam.

[h1]1. Be official group member[/h1]
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/GXBu0Yg.png[/IMG]
We give 1000-10000 Cash to everyone who joins LoveBeat. More Cash paid according to the official group members.
[b]Amount of Cash[/b]
1. Less than 5000 members: Give 1000 Cash to everyone
2. More than 5000 - Less than 10000: Give 3000 Cash to everyone
3. More than 10000 - Less than 15000: Give 5000 Cash to everyone
4. More than 15000 - Less than 20000: Give 7500 Cash to everyone
5. More than 20000 members: Give 10000 Cash to everyone
* You must have LoveBeat in-game character to get Cash before maintenance on 10th Feb.
* During maintenance on 10th Feb, the number of official group member is checked and Cash is provided directly to players. (Check the number here: http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290 )

[h1]2. Check daily attendance and get 100% DC coupon[/h1]
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/eWNU7Ft.png[/IMG]
You will be able to get 250000 Beat and 100% DC coupon every month as attendance gifts will be changed. Only in January, there is a 100% DC coupon as additional 15 days attendance gift.
* Read Tips about how to get attendance attendance gifts.

[h1]3. Gather Fam member and get permanent set[/h1]
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/4roTqAk.png[/IMG]
We give items to 3 Fam(Clan) which gather most Fam member during event period.
[b]Rewards[/b]
- 1st rank Fam: Permanent Set (Clan Uniform), 30days Fam Skin (Graffiti Family Skin)
- 2nd rank Fam: 30days Accessory (Toy Hammer), 30days Fam Skin (Gothic Family Skin)
- 3rd rank Fam: 30days Balloon (Purple Monster)
* Family skin is provided only to the Fam master. Other rewards are provided to everyone who joins the Fam at the MA. If you had joined the Fam but you left the fam before MA, You couldn’t get the rewards.
* The number of Fam member is checked at launching time (13th Jan) and MA time (10th Feb). We didn’t consider the changes between that check time.
* Read Tips about our Fam System.

[h1]4. Weekly mode play event[/h1]
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/OETgZST.png[/IMG]
You can get 8 Permanent accessories to play the modes.
[b]Period: 13th Jan – 19th Jan[/b]
- Play 10 times with Individual Classic mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Cat Umbrella Hat)
- Play 10 times with Team Survival mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Enjoy/Feel the Music)
[b]Period: 20th Jan – 26th Jan[/b]
- Play 10 times with Nonstop Crazy mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Whalley)
- Play 10 times with Couple PangPang mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Hear Beat)
[b]Period: 27th Jan – 2nd Feb[/b]
- Play 10 times with Beat PangPang mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Sharks Eye Bag)
- Play 10 times with Bomb Bomb mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Bandage world/Heart in the cheek)
[b]Period: 3rd Feb – 9th Feb[/b]
- Play 10 times with Two out of three Fam battle mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Bring it on)
- Play 10 times with Meeting Party propose mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Heart Shades)
* The reward will be provided every Wednesday to your mail box. Depending on character gender, the rewards are different.

[h1]5. Weekly style contest[/h1]
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/S5WznIk.png[/IMG]
Post your style and get equipped item for free.
[b]Period[/b]
1st Period: 13th Jan – 19th Jan
2nd Period: 20th Jan – 26th Jan
3rd Period: 27th Jan – 2nd Feb
4th Period: 3rd Feb – 9th Feb
[b]Mechanics[/b]
1. Decorate your character at Shop
2. Click “Save your current style” button
3. Find the image saved at [My Document\CrazyDiamond\LoveBeat\MyOutfit]
4. Upload the image on Artwork of our game hub with your character’s nickname and equipped item’s name. (update here http://steamcommunity.com/app/354290/images/ )
[b]How to choose winner[/b]
1 female and 1 male character will be chosen as best stylist according to unique visitors, votes, etc of the post.
[b]Rewards[/b]
Give the items equipped in the image of your post. (period of use is 7 days-old.)
* Announcement of best stylist is on every Thursday and the rewards will be provided every Thursday to in-game mail.

[h1]Tips[/h1]
* Read “3-1. STAMP” and “7. FAM System” session about how to get attendance gifts and make your own Fam.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=560975319
* You can check in-game image of rewards.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=594819076
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=594820483

[h1]Result (Winners) of "5 Open Events"[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/354290/discussions/0/458607518210983638/

Don't miss those events!
Thank you.

We give items to 3 Fam(Clan) which gather most Fam member during event period.
[b]Rewards[/b]
- 1st rank Fam: Permanent Set (Clan Uniform), 30days Fam Skin (Graffiti Family Skin)
- 2nd rank Fam: 30days Accessory (Toy Hammer), 30days Fam Skin (Gothic Family Skin)
- 3rd rank Fam: 30days Balloon (Purple Monster)
* Family skin is provided only to the Fam master. Other rewards are provided to everyone who joins the Fam at the MA. If you had joined the Fam but you left the fam before MA, You couldn’t get the rewards.
* The number of Fam member is checked at launching time (13th Jan) and MA time (10th Feb). We didn’t consider the changes between that check time.
* Read Tips about our Fam System.

[h1]4. Weekly mode play event[/h1]
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/OETgZST.png[/IMG]
You can get 8 Permanent accessories to play the modes.
[b]Period: 13th Jan – 19th Jan[/b]
- Play 10 times with Individual Classic mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Cat Umbrella Hat)
- Play 10 times with Team Survival mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Enjoy/Feel the Music)
[b]Period: 20th Jan – 26th Jan[/b]
- Play 10 times with Nonstop Crazy mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Whalley)
- Play 10 times with Couple PangPang mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Hear Beat)
[b]Period: 27th Jan – 2nd Feb[/b]
- Play 10 times with Beat PangPang mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Sharks Eye Bag)
- Play 10 times with Bomb Bomb mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Bandage world/Heart in the cheek)
[b]Period: 3rd Feb – 9th Feb[/b]
- Play 10 times with Two out of three Fam battle mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Bring it on)
- Play 10 times with Meeting Party propose mode -> Get 1 Permanent Acc (Heart Shades)
* The reward will be provided every Wednesday to your mail box. Depending on character gender, the rewards are different.

[h1]5. Weekly style contest[/h1]
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/S5WznIk.png[/IMG]
Post your style and get equipped item for free.
[b]Period[/b]
1st Period: 13th Jan – 19th Jan
2nd Period: 20th Jan – 26th Jan
3rd Period: 27th Jan – 2nd Feb
4th Period: 3rd Feb – 9th Feb
[b]Mechanics[/b]
1. Decorate your character at Shop
2. Click “Save your current style” button
3. Find the image saved at [My Document\CrazyDiamond\LoveBeat\MyOutfit]
4. Upload the image on Artwork of our game hub with your character’s nickname and equipped item’s name. (update here http://steamcommunity.com/app/354290/images/ )
[b]How to choose winner[/b]
1 female and 1 male character will be chosen as best stylist according to unique visitors, votes, etc of the post.
[b]Rewards[/b]
Give the items equipped in the image of your post. (period of use is 7 days-old.)
* Announcement of best stylist is on every Thursday and the rewards will be provided every Thursday to in-game mail.

[h1]Tips[/h1]
* Read “3-1. STAMP” and “7. FAM System” session about how to get attendance gifts and make your own Fam.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=560975319
* You can check in-game image of rewards.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=594819076
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=594820483

[h1]Result (Winners) of "5 Open Events"[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/354290/discussions/0/458607518210983638/

Don't miss those events!
Thank you.
